notes.title: Back from a small vacation!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Some of you guys might be curious about the delay of the next patch. I took some time off at the beginning of the year, got out of the country, and freshened up a bit. Now I am more than happy to be back to working on Mini Healer again!

While I was away I was also following the chatter/discussion a bit and would like to answer some questions as well!

Q: When is the full release
A: For now I am looking at June ish time to fully finish the things I want to implement (check below). Though that might collide with some popular AAA releases this year so it might get moved a bit back if that's the case (and it gives me more time :D)

Q: What are the things left until the full release
A: 
- Small revamp of the tower (check below to see what's in it)
- A bit more extension of depth (1-2 new end-game bosses)
- Steam achievements (one of the top requested ones)
- Tons of balancing
- Tons of QoL such as item comparison
- An attempt to slow down the game in the early game, probably between level 10-40 ish. Sometimes I feel like things are introduced quite frequently so just adding more things to do as a speed bump during the early game
- Stretch goal: Controller support, this one depends on if I have time left to revamp the UI a bit to support it, if not then it'll have to wait until after the full release

Q: When's the next patch coming
A: With the next patch I want to knock down the tower part and the item comparison part. There are 2 main changes that'll come to the tower
- An infinite mode
- A way to customize not only spells but individual party members (sort of like equipping them individually! See screenshot below)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/9c4eb2dae65dd4c6d24988378f8df5336b1e740c.png

These are big changes that need pretty big testing and balancing so I would limit the scope of the next patch to just that. I am aiming to have it on the beta branch at the end of March and live around the beginning of April

Q: Will the price of the game increase after the release?
A: Yes, however, it will not be that much of an increase. 


Hope this answers some of your questions! If all is well I will see you in March! Feel free to reach out on the game's discord server if you have questions as well!

Cheers,
Sad Doge

notes.title: Patch 0.92 - Cloud Save
notes.content:
The long-awaited cloud save is here! I have enabled the cloud save option on Steam and the updated game should be able to work with it! ːsteamhappyː

As a reminder, with cloud save now enabled this effectively means there will only be 5 save slots out of all your devices instead of 5 per device. 

If you have another save file on another device and you happen to sync that save file to the cloud by playing on that device first. Then the next time you open up the game on other devices, the game will have to ask you to choose one save to keep in that save slot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/8cf660fac0213fa08ea6309d80709a77c8695fa3.png

As always, if you ever feel unsure about something, you can always find and backup your save files here before hitting confirm!

C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\MiniHealer\MiniHealer - Live branch
C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\MiniHealer\MiniHealer\Beta - Beta branch

Anything with _Cloud suffix will be the ones sync to Steam and usually the _Cloud files will be the same as their original copy.

Aaand say If you accidentally chose the wrong one, you can try to find an archived version of the save file under the Archive folder as well, sometimes you might just find one!
C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\MiniHealer\MiniHealer\Archive

Hopefully this update will solve the multi-device problem once and for all!

Saddoge

notes.title: What I am working on (Patch 0.9)
notes.content:
I hope everyone had a great Christmas and a great start into the new year!

It's been around a month since you have heard from me so I am excited to share what I am working on next! Keep in mind that some of these changes might turn out to be slightly different with the way they are described as I do more testing/gather more feedback.

End game End game End game!
I genuinely appreciate all the feedback I have received. Especially feedback towards how they are sad that the game is now over once they have beaten all the bosses and gotten all the achievements. Although I must say all good things must come to an end. But 0.9 will definitely focus on more things to do in the endgame. With more challenging bosses and more exciting items!

Detph
There are a couple of things I want to do with the current depth system

- The current monster enhancement system is weird in the sense that most of the attributes are flat-out ignorable and have no impact. What made it worse is that there is no explanation of what the attribute is so this patch will address that by redesigning each attribute as well as adding a new indicator of what they are.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/15024beadb287099ec94edde1fd50c7e0832a48f.png

- The OG bosses such as Bone Knight and Gump told me that they feel a bit sad that they went from scary bosses into a more trash mob in depth. So this patch some of them will come back with a vengeance in their Uber form. Defeating them might also drop some special jewels as well!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/974fb8ed25496c01a1a2305f0b39a29287c3fe55.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/16e8516070494bac89bf376f86dc1ef5b1247e99.gif

- The game has a maximum level of 100 but there is already a sudo-paragon level in the game that's mastery level. In 0.9 I want to explore the idea of moving that concept into its own paragon level system. Won't be anything too crazy, mostly just putting the mechanics of continuing leveling under a spotlight so more people notice it.

- There are also going to be more crafting options and more ways to obtain those rare crafting materials!

Tower
It's been amazing seeing all the tower feedback and improvements. But I think the tower can be much more than what it is. The goal is to make it so that each run of the Tower will feel significantly different even if you chose the same spell and same party. These are some of the things that are coming.

- Floor 3, the Pinnacle, will be available!

- More skills for party members and you to pick from!

- Skill augmentation during the run to make it so that a Lesser Heal run might feel completely different if you augment your Lesser Heal differently

Sprite Improvements/New Transmogs
A big thanks to one of the community members who wanted to help out on improving some of the character sprites and trasnmogs. So in 0.9 I'll look to see if I can integrate it into the system! For folks who like the original transmogs there will also be a classic version with it
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/0b23c24af04ac3c98eae782ed5cfeeba855e7ff2.png

I am also looking to add in some full-body transmogs for other party members but depending on the time I might only add it for 1 party member for 0.9 (rest will still be coming!)

Balance Thoughts
I think generally the balance of things stands in a pretty good place. Most things are balanced but there are definitely still weaker builds and talents/items combinations that are way too strong than other builds. In 0.9 I would focus on buffing the weaker builds/items and bring the power level of some specific items/talents back in line a bit.

Quality of Life
Some of you might have noticed that there are a few minor patches 0.81 - 0.83. Previously I think it was not a good idea to bundle these QoL changes with the release of the next major patch. So for patch 0.9 I experimented with just finishing all the QoL changes I planned for 0.9 first and releasing them before the content work has started. So these changes are already live! Some of these changes include

- Better talent/skill hover indicator ✅
- Nifty roll information added to the atlas/crafting menu that tells you what can an item roll✅
- Display shield values✅
- Ability to bind multiple keys (shift + 1)✅
- Enhanced skill indicator (tells you when your Ample Heal is free!) ✅

There are going to be more smaller QoL changes bundled with 0.9 but at this point nothing too crazy.


Localization
I also hope to sync up all Japanese/Korean localization in 0.9 so I can say the game officially supports those 2 languages.

Huge thank you to all the community members who either localize the game or help suggest localization improvements. For anyone who wants to help out keep in mind that all the texts of the game are open source here!
https://github.com/minihealer/MiniHealerText

Timeline
Because 0.9 is pretty chunky, I am looking at around the end of February for it to be on the beta branch and mid-March for the live branch release. The theme for future patches before 1.0 will also be similar to 0.9 which mainly focused on end game as well. With QoL and improvements splashing in.


Thanks again for your support for the game and see you in 0.9!
Saddoge

notes.title: What I am working on (Patch 0.8)
notes.content:
Wow, I can't believe we are at patch 0.8 already starting from 0.2 or something. What an amazing journey and we still have a couple of major patches to hit before 1.0!

As stated in 0.7, Airene Tower will be the last brand new major system before the release. So I want all subsequent major patches to focus on polish/content/balance. I think we can all agree that not all the existing systems in the game are perfect and some can definitely need upgrade/work based on the feedback and trend that I have been seeing. With that said, 0.8 will be pretty exciting and here are some spoilers!

Campaign/Boss Balancing +Rework
There are a couple of things I want to do to make the campaign better. I noticed when the Soul Quarter is unlocked a lot of people tend to move fully into it. Then when they realize there are still some insane difficulty bosses in the Vault Entrance they are usually fairly overleveled at that point so it makes the first part becomes a wash. So in the upcoming patch I'll be tweaking the flow slightly. 

All bosses are going to get a revisit as well, not all of them will be changed significantly. 
Some bosses are still very build-hatey if one still remember the old aura-hate guy. While I think build-hate bosses are ok, but they probably shouldn't be on the critical path(the campaign). In 0.8 I'll be removing or reworking bosses that are very build-hatey from the campaign and they will possibly come back later in the game with some tweaks instead!

I also would like the bosses to be slower, meaning instead of chaining abilities back to back, I would like the boss to have some time in between abilities but the abilities will be more impactful. This way the fight can be less chaotic and easier to plan and strategize what is coming next. 

Another changes that will be coming will be the difficulty ramp up from Outer Courtyard to Guardians' Cave. Currently I noticed most people feel no need to engage with the crafting system until Guardians and that makes the difficulty spike feel a lot worse. The idea was to encourage people to engage with the crafting system starting from Outer Courtyard so the next patch I would be focusing on balancing around that area.

I would also be looking into reworking a couple of older bosses. The goal is to let each boss have very unique abilities and spells so if there is a boss that just feel too generic then it is going to get a mini rework. Bosses that are already unique such as Izki(The wind guy), won't get a rework.

Airene Tower Changes
Thank you guys for all the tower feedback! The tower is definitely in its infancy so any feedback is much appreciated. Lot of people have reflected the fact that mana restoration shouldn't be as punishing. While I agree and mana will most likely be restored to full in the 0.8 tower, the mana drought mechanic  will most likely still exist but wont' be as punishing or turned on by default. Instead it will be...

in the Chaos Tower! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/41d4173ec00829b4081117bfaaf2925eaa6811af.gif
Once you beat the tower once you can add on different difficulties to the tower, changing the dynamic and difficulty of it and gaining more Solarsilk for your trouble!

Next patch I will also do a clean up to tower artifacts/blessings that have very minimal impact. The goal is to make each run feel new and fresh. Right now I don't think the goal is hit yet but with time it will get there!

Full-body Transmogs
Tower update also come with the addition of full body transmogs! Here are a couple of spoilers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/1ebe5556a1d7a07c6837c403abf6c84cd73ffcf4.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/f6e4c348c6a3fdaa833dc5ad97ce1944cbca8dd1.gif


New Key!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/86108754ed0a4a231cb982da81d8889057566f8c.png
New content, new bosses, new items in depth. Nuff said!

UI/UX
In 0.8 I have gone through all the game's UI and made some tweaks ranging from small adjustment to rework. These are all based on the questions/trends that I have been seeing so hopefully this will now make the UI more intuitive (as well as making them look better!)

Here are the new updated Armory and Talent UI for some spoilers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/e72ce42e4c3dcf429dbbb80451a2e8a947c18094.png
Armory UI changed so that the material filter is not mixed in with the artifact filters, and the sockets have moved and have better instruction on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/e9e1608fee77fd7e9d1c674e4b8c9bf293a0ef47.png
Center the tree as a whole and merged the masteries section into the talent overview/detail instead of its own section.

New Soundtracks!
Personally I feel like one of the weak spot of the game is the soundtracks. While I feel like main soundtrack is pretty good but overall it certainly lacks variety. In 0.8 and subsequent major patches I'll be looking to add in more and more soundtracks!

Timeline
A ton of stuffs are going into 0.8 so I would expect it to be ~1-2 month of work. I am aiming to finish the changes and start testing at the end of Sept and the patch will hit live mid to late October

There are many small to medium improvements that will also be coming to 0.8 as well. As always, don't hesitate to ask any questions that you may have! You can always find me on the discord server https://discord.gg/3yU64jK

notes.title: What I am working on (Patch 0.7)
notes.content:
Onwards to the sky ːsteamhappyː (Quite literally this patch)! The development of 0.7 has already been underway for a couple of weeks and I feel like I am at a point where I can share what's coming next!

Transmogs
We don't just want to kill bosses and heal, we want to kill and heal with style! 0.7 will introduce the transmog system that will change the look of everyone's weapons and shields!

https://media.giphy.com/media/vxVwyiZpTxSawWqLsq/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/xYFKbL8SLiwZThvhaK/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/hNKoNDse7AgAtw0UaP/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/KcIVKdYRESseHpx4D7/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/QW5UuqNGfsNUh5Vhd8/giphy.gif

Before you ask, yes there will be helm and armor transmogs in the future! Currently I am just trying to keep the scope of 0.7 to be more realistic. 

And before you ask again, all transmogs will be free as well as fully unlockable in game with no MTX!

So...how do we unlock those transmogs....


Introducing the Airene Tower
https://media.giphy.com/media/a4aPvw3Rq1e58BT5Z5/giphy.gif

Airene Tower is the last major endgame system before the full release. While a lot of people love the theory crafting and coming up with the perfect build to blast the hardest bosses the game has to offer, a lot of people also love the intensity of the early game as well as using limited resources to progress. And the latter will be the game mode that Airene Tower offers.

Airene Tower will be an isolated and experimental rougelike experience where you can climb a Slay the Spire inspired map system to see if you can reach the top and defeat the pinnacle boss above! You will also earn unique currency along the climb to unlock transmogs for your team.

Airene Tower will also be a complete horizontal engame/progression system parallel to the current endgame system Depth. Meaning things you earn in Depth will not help you climb higher in the tower and things you earn in a tower run will also not increase your party's power outside (but the transmogs are kept and you will look epic everywhere).

The overall idea is that once you defeat the Guardians and you want to continue to craft and minmax your build, you can go down to Depth and challenge the toughest bosses the game has to offer. Or if you want to re-experience the game without having to go though all the same tutorials/bosses you can go up to Airene Tower and have a way of replaying the game while getting transmog progression (or do both of them!). Future content patches will also focus on both endgame systems such as adding tougher bosses and stronger artifacts in Depth and adding more varieties of enemies/events/blessings in the tower. 

Monster Changes
Since Airene Tower's development is a big one I will keep it lighter on the other things this patch. For monster changes in 0.7 I will be reworking the keywords that the Depth monsters have. Aka the occasional Pacified, Relentless...etc.

They are not as impactful as I thought and no one really knows what they do. 0.7 will try to make those clearer as well as making them more impactful

Balance Changes
0.6 introduced the Paladin class and I am very pleased with how the class turned out. It definitely offered a different playstyle. However, since some strong Priest talents were transferred to Paladin, Priest is now a little bit weaker than the other classes. 0.7 will be buffing up some Priest talents/items as well as adding more items for other classes. Some endgame builds will also receive a small nerf to bring their powerlevel to be more inline with the other builds while some will receive some buffs.

Localization
0.6 also brought in the Simplified and Traditional Chinese localization and the text system seems to be working great!!  All the translation done to this point were by the community, it is truly amazing and I am very thankful!

The community has also finished the initial Russian and Japanese translation(currently on the beta branch). If you would like to help out with any translation, I open sourced the entire game's texts here https://github.com/minihealer/MiniHealerText for anyone who is interested in chipping in and making the translation better and better.

I hope to fully add in Russian/Japanese/Korean/Spanish with 0.9 (not 0.7), which should be later this year. (whether or not they are done by the community or I will work with an agency to do so)

Timeline
0.7 is a beast with a complete new system. I would expect the patch to go live around mid to end of June!

As always, don't hesitate to ask any questions that you may have! You can always find me on the discord server https://discord.gg/3yU64jK

Thanks again for your support for the game! I can't believe we are at 0.7 already, there are still a couple of more major patches to go before 1.0, see you soon!

Saddoge

notes.title: What I am working on (Patch 0.6)
notes.content:
Onwards to the moon ːsteamhappyː! The development of 0.6 has already begun and I can't wait to share with you guys about what's coming in 0.6!

A New Class
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/318b74574e93e0722c3a4353d17dc656b28fb5d2.png
That's right, one of the Early Access promises is to add 1 more class into the existing game and it is now time to fulfill that promise in 0.6. To keep things a bit secret I won't say what the new class will be but most of you can probably guess from the description below.


 A few of the talents of the new class already exist in the current Priest talent tree. So for the new class some talents in Priest will be pulled out into the new talent tree. Then new Priest talents will be backfilled back into the Priest tree.
 The new class will be a defensive focused class that excels in single target healing, but weaker in AOE healing
 The new class will also bring its own mechanic, the spells will change or add additional effects based on the previous spell cast so there are more room for combo style healing


Of course I brought some gifs as well to showcase some of the new spells!
https://media.giphy.com/media/gsIBRfIfo1BaXVH905/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/Alr4HEExm5uFFICyCO/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/79pL5oh8U4XwDXAqIY/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/dcZSuIad2wFpnXQnyS/giphy.gif



Difficulty Changes
Currently if you want to play on hardmode but not hardcore you can't really do that. So some improvements I want to make here is to split out the difficulty of the enemies with the special flags like hardcore or explorer.

Doing so will also allow people to switch between difficulties without having to have to create a new save slot

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/dc62a38f1bf51f56badd79468c1de54439e369da.png



Endgame Improvements
I am quite happy with what 0.5 brought to the table for end game. 0.6 will continue to strengthen it by adding new keys and new bosses into the depth system.

0.6 will also bring a way to craft gears in the end game. Currently if you are at the very very end of the game and you want to obtain the absolute best item the only way the game offers is to reroll the entire stats of the item until you hit ones you like. 0.6 will offer another system that will help towards slowly getting that godly end game gear you want!   



Localization
That's right! I will finish upgrading the entire text system in 0.6, [strike]which will for sure cause some text bugs[/strike]. That should allow the localization to begin as well. Based on the stats that Steam is telling me I will most likely start with Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese first, then look to add in more and more languages throughout the year! I am not sure if the full localization will be finished and live with 0.6 but if not then it will be live before I start to work on 0.7.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/30df412a2fa87840b98d91b00728549b16d26184.png

That's it! Creating a new class as well as localization is a lot of work so I am expecting this patch to take slightly longer than 0.5. I would expect the patch to go live around the beginning of April!

As always, don't hesitate to ask any questions that you may have! You can always find me on the discord server https://discord.gg/3yU64jK

Thanks again for your support for the game!

notes.title: What I am working on (Patch 0.5)
notes.content:
The patch train can not and will not stop! Here are some things I want to bring into the next major patch and I am more than excited to share this with you guys!

Overall I want to keep the scope of patch 0.5 smaller as 0.4 was a bloated one for sure. Patch 0.5 aims to beef up the existing content instead of changing it.

End game improvements
There are a 2 main things I want to address here. 

First being the transition into the end game, currently there is a big power gap between the guardians and the Abyss monsters. Having a power gap between them is ok but I feel like the gap is a bit too wide at the moment since they are technically not the hardest content anymore and there are many more challenges ahead. So I'll be aiming to shift some of their power into the new end game system.

Secondly, the current end game is not really impressive as you basically just keep going down the Infinite Corridor until you get tired. Patch 0.5 will aim to build a more robust and flexible end game system that is similar to the map systems in various ARPGs. Below is a sneak peek into the new system.
https://media.giphy.com/media/w6zrzLWcOO8bfpq2n6/giphy.gif

And there will be many new encounters that you will see in the new depth system and the map will be randomized every time!

Combat logs
Many people really want to the ability to view a more detailed breakdown of skills' healing/damage after battles. Well, patch 0.5 will make that into a reality and I will just let the gif explains itself.

The combat log will be available on every boss fight.

https://media.giphy.com/media/G64Lups4AXYytPSOpS/giphy.gif

New Crafting UI
Many people also find it hard to navigate around crafting an item, as well as clarity on what does some of the upgrade means for an item. Patch 0.5 will introduce a proper blacksmith and a new UI that will be dedicated to upgrading/crafting your items!
https://media.giphy.com/media/0p12K4GgALbRZD4OfU/giphy.gif

Artifacts
Overall artifacts and builds are in a relatively solid place but with the new end game system I feel like it can go a bit further so there are 2 main things I want to focus here as well.

First is to increase the maximum tier of the randomly generated items but slowly plateauing the power level of stats at higher level to avoid power creep. Think about it as a sigmoidal growth instead of pure exponential. This will most likely require heavy tuning here but that should open up more end game upgrade options

Second is to start introducing party focused builds. Currently the game has a lot of single party member builds where you focus on one party member to hyper carry the group, which is completely okay but it is time for party builds to get some love!

System update
Of course I am not forgetting to continue on the system update for our international friends here. I aim to  bring the localization system to ~60% done after 0.5. Thanks for your patience!

That's it! Short and sweet update, I aim to finish the content before the end of year and start testing it around that time as well. Which means the patch will most likely go live early January!

Thanks again for your support for the game!
Saddoge

notes.title: Development Notes - Version 0.4
notes.content:
Hello guys,

It's been a while since I posted news about the next patch. I am now very happy to share that the next patch is very close to being completed and moving into testing. Now that what's been changed is more or less developed, I am super excited to share some of the development notes for the next patch! 

Patch 0.4 will probably be the biggest patch up to date and also one of the patches that changes the game fundamentally(not too much). For this patch I will recommend even for people who has finished the game to do a restart to experience the changes.


Movement
The biggest change that patch 0.4 brings is the ability to move the Healer(or yourself) during battle, that's right, no strings attached anymore. 

Below is a quick demonstration on how movement works during battle
https://media.giphy.com/media/wH0A3t4d6Z65eTPeLv/giphy.gif

Q: Why did you decide to add in movement?

The last boss of patch 0.3 received very good feedback on the design of its mechanic, but players also feels a bit weird that you need to use the button to move instead of exposing it as hotkeys. Problem with just exposing it as hotkeys would be too confusing for new players who see the move hotkeys but haven't seen the boss yet. Making it so that you can move across all bosses will make it more consistent and justify showing the keybindings of the movement in the settings right from the start of the game
Movement can increase the immersion of the battle as well as open more doors into movement based new skills/talents in the future.
Movement can also open up a lot of doors to new boss mechanics and design. I will talk about that more in the next section
 

Q: There are already many things that we need to keep track of, wouldn't adding in movement be too much to handle?
For sure there are already many things to keep an eye on during the battle such as health bars, enemy debuffs, enemy buffs, environmental effects...etc. Adding in movement on top of those will be very frantic if not done properly. I would say the approach that I took would be to limit the amount of mechanics per boss to be manageable. For example, a boss that has dangerous movement based mechanics will probably not have dangerous debuffs so you won't need to focus on everything at once. This adds to the fun of investigating and figuring out what is the most dangerous ability a boss has and focus on that ability.


Bosses
Nearly 50-60% of the bosses in 0.3 has received changes, from minor tweaks to gaining new ability to completely reworked. This is to reinforce the ability to move all the way from Bone Knight, but the focus here is actually the Outer/Inner Courtyards, currently there are many feedback that some courtyard bosses are a bit unfair and uninteresting (Sid, Volkan, Thogg & Mhogg ...etc). So, Patch 0.4 will completely rework 7/11 of the Ourter/Inner Courtyard bosses, they are essentially new bosses! That's also the reason why a restart of the game will also feel fresh!

Below are some of the new abilities that the old bosses gained and new bosses have.
https://media.giphy.com/media/Xe9xNVHJ3Rp4FX6km8/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/TwQV4ls0nkHFJyKfOQ/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/V3Hs8ITZWPKz5qb42K/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/K5IjtyhuD6RtTBJnk8/giphy.gif


Story, Quests, and Dialogs
Yes! An ARPG will need a story along with quests and dialogs. Patch 0.4 will bring a super super simple story into the game, along with NPCs, quest systems, and dialogs. Those will be very simple as I believe story is needed but not overly important. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/2fffe5acc98194c2409f73212e0ae7d8d602bd48.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/16b6874df666274caf5a6490ae5e32427cec22c9.png

Adding in quests and dialogs systems also allow me to rework other systems easily such as the trio rework mentioned below


Orra, Mevor, and Edwin (The Trio)
I don't mind the current trio system the game has, but it's a bit repetitive as going from level 1-9 are basically the same mechanics with just a stats boost. I like the flavor of you only need to do them once, in which the quest system above can fullfill just that. Now they each have their own questlines and each quest will be different so they will feel less repetitive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/a5325672e942aa51dc2075ca398121c8e3fec128.png

Skills
A lot of people voiced that Dispel and Negate are too much of a hassle to put in/take out every fight. Patch 0.4 will now lock Dispel and Negate onto the cast bar so that you won't be able to take them off, as a result of that, the cast slots will now be increase to 8 (Pog)!

It is not over yet! Patch 0.4 will also rework and bring a total of 4 new skills to the table each with different dynamics and interaction. I will show case 2 of them below.

- Cleansing Ray - A channeling heal ability 
https://media.giphy.com/media/tWuzdzztk5xkxYUSPZ/giphy.gif

- Restoration Totem - A zone based healing ability 
https://media.giphy.com/media/fSsxujLxZeK1GsYexP/giphy.gif


Talents
Of course with the new skills there will be new talents that support it. The patch will also rework some of the talents that are weak and can't really scale into the late game that well. But overall  I would say talents are already in a good place so there won't be too much changes to the existing talents

Artifacts
I have to thank the community for this one first, the discord community noted down the discussion for each artifact that was discussed and the proposal of its changes. I read through all of them and agreed with 80-85% of the proposals. So now some of the old and not popular items have been reworked based on the suggestions. Below are a few spoilers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/9784ade094adb24f6f4abea10db70fe00329430d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/48c0bb78c0fc78fcca4fcabb8e00d417b092292e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/cd9a48907c2b0358d1fd6e41c16ac473d5c75184.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37354023/68a726e13f839db41a3435d90077b2ccdb283f34.png

Of course there are also my own tweaking and balancing as well as new items to support the new skills.

Healing? Or Damage?
There are a couple of feedback where people were saying the game doesn't feel like healing towards the mid to late game. I agree and this would be a tough one to solve for sure. But the approach here would be to be more open to both worlds as there are people who wants to go for DPS and people who wants more healing. I am planning to follow these directions - 

During the early to mid game there shouldn't be items that once you get it you can breeze through the content without having to heal, either due to way superior damage or superior passive healing. So early items that do those will be changed a bit, but the late game version of them will stay the same.

Again during the early to mid to game you also shouldn't feel like you need to focus on DPS in order to beat a boss. Of course there are DPS checks but those will be relatively low for the early bosses.

As for the end game, I would keep it more open as if you want to keep optimize for healing you can, if you want to build a passive healing build you can, and if you want to build a pure DPS bloodlust machine you also can. So late game damaging items will mostly stay the game.

Other good things

Steam Cloud Save - Patch 0.4 will enable Steam Cloud Save :hype:. But I would still save a copy of the save code before it is live (just in case)
Quality of life/Bug fixes - Patch 0.4 will also bring many QoLs and bug fixes such as the ability to rename save slots as well as hovering onto things like Vigor Aura on items will show you want that is instead of you going into combat and figuring it out
Localization - I know there are many international friends who want to try out the game. Patch 0.4 will bring the localization system to about 40% done. I am aiming for it to be 100% done and can start localization in patch 0.5
 

There are many other changes in Patch 0.4 but this should summarize all the big ones. Thank you for reading all the way to here and supporting the game/providing valuable feedback! As you can see the patch is bigger than the usual big patches so the testing might take a bit longer. I would expect the patch to go live in about 3-4 weeks!

Thanks,
Sad Doge

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Patch 0.3.0 is now live!

Below is a quick development note and a detailed patch note:

First of all the patch brings the first set of end game into the game, the Infinite Corridor. 
Infinite Corridor is a simple depth system that scales infinitely, in it there is a new boss(more will be added), new items and materials to acquire, as well as new crafting options to be unlocked.

Secondly, the patch also aim to loosen up the grind of the mid-late game by increasing the speed of leveling up in the later stage of the game. Levels are less and less impactful as you progress into the later stage so the game shouldn't make you feel like you need to be the same level to beat a boss.
Hopefully with the combination of the FAQ section, the game can point you in the right direction to increase your strength via items/crafting towards the end game instead of only trying to grind for more levels.

Stone of Madness has always been a problematic artifact as it is the only way one can acquire artifact with a base quality over 10 and it feels very required in the late game.
This patch will now put the original effect of Stone of Madness into Chaotic levels while still keep the theme of the stone to be risk/reward focused.
This also means all the levels can now become Chaotic, including the guardians. Since the guardians can become Chaotic, their normal strength can now go down, which will not only reduce the initial difficulty spike between the Courtyards and Guardians, but also provide reasonable challenge to those who want it.

The patch also comes with a slew of quality of life/clarity changes. Focusing on questions/suggestions that frequently come up on the Discord. This should be a step in the right direction to bring more clarity into the game.

Lastly, the patch also improves some systems internally, you probably won't notice anything(unless something got broken :rip:). But these improvements will help towards future content/localization/game performance etc...


Thanks again for supporting the game and check below for a more detailed patch notes!
Sad Doge


===Bosses====
- Bosses' maximum resistances scaled from 95% to 90%
- Normal Gump now always drops both Simple Sword and Simple Shield
- Guardians now has a higher chance of dropping items with tier 12 attributes
- Septius's Crystal now always gives 3.5% of maximum mana back per attack instead of based on damage dealt
- Septius's Crystal now always heals for a 0.15% of maximum health back per attack instead of based on damage dealt
- Sargaris now prioritizes Channel Heal over other spells
- Sargaris' Channel Heal feedback is now health loss instead of damage
- Clara's Curse now deals Nemesis damage instead of Fire
- Keto has been moved to the Infinite Corridor
- Keto's Puppet Master Awaken now also remove all dread stacks
- Keto's Puppetfy behavior changed to randomly targeting instead of Berzerker first
- Guaridans can now become Chaotic up to 1 crystal
- Aurdon's immune to healing phase now has a visual shield
- The Lowmore and The Abyss can now become Chaotic up to 1 crystal
- All normal Guardians health reduced by 40%
- All normal Guardians damage reduced by 30%

notes.title: What I am working on
notes.content:
Hello guys,

It's been almost 2 months since Mini Healer launched into Early Access. First of all I would like to thank everyone here for supporting the game and providing honestly tons of great feedback.

As you can probably tell, throughout 2 months the main focus was to fix the bugs, adding essential quality of life changes, as well as fixing major balancing issues. I believe the game has improved significantly once again after the 2 months and I have you guys to thank for all the feedback!

Though not all the feedback and suggestions were implemented but I promise I have read through most if not all of them and kept it somewhere safe :), some of them will be rolled out with other content patches.

Throughout the next month or 2 I will be switching back to focusing on adding more content into the game so the next patch will be slower, but it will also be bigger. Without spoiling too much here's what you can expect in the upcoming patch.

- Infinite dungeons
- New end game boss/bosses
- New items
- Small rework on some of the chaos systems

Of course the patch will come with its own slew of bug fixes, quality of life, and balancing changes as well. 


Some things that are further on the horizon but definitely on my list:
- Steam Cloud
- Steam Achievement
- Localization
and many more!

Again thanks for supporting the game and provided valuable feedback! The game is definitely not complete, at least from my point of view, so I am very excited to continue working on it. 

Thanks,
Sad Doge
